programme.title: 王者争霸 #12
programme.desc: 撒哈拉以南的纬度为繁多的战士提供了多样性的战场。雄性长颈鹿像落锤一样摆动头部,斑马拥有动物王国中最强大的踢腿,黑猩猩的战争异常地似曾相识。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #3
programme.desc: 准备好在滨海湾的斗殴吧,在安娜和她的海滨家族远在上游时,游牧人和城里人家族占领了她的领地。在这个海湾的合法主人突然返回之前,暂时享受一下这个豪华水道中平静的水濑生活吧。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #4
programme.desc: 欢迎安娜的族群回到海滨湾, 那里有两个擅自闯入的水獭家族。当米娅嗅到安娜的气味并将汤尼族群赶得远远的时候,牠感受到了压力。然后,当游牧族群对即将发生的冲突一无所知时,请抓紧时间。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #2
programme.desc: 走访婆罗洲的红树林,与湾鳄一同航行,并见证牠们在盘根错节的水生植物之间穿梭自如。了解牠们如何利用环境调节体温,以及如何凭借惊人的耐性一跃成为顶尖猎手。

programme.title: 熊宝贝训练营 #3
programme.desc: 跟随温斯顿和姐妹花搬进新建的居所,并努力学习野外生存技能。目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼儿园中的权力斗争,然后关注不安分的幼熊维克多;因为牠突然跛脚,野放的日子要一再延后。

programme.title: 熊宝贝训练营 #4
programme.desc: 与雅思敏和雅拉一起在雨中嬉戏和享受攀爬的乐趣,并跟随温斯顿在新水池中的畅泳。与罗杰和史蒂夫一起寻找掉落的无线电项圈,并见证两群夏季幼熊的首次相遇。

programme.title: 大猫国度 #2
programme.desc: 在卢安瓜谷,荷里活狮群大难临头。流浪雄狮的侵袭使女族长阿华受了重伤。由于首领丧失能力,狩猎变得困难。在寻找狮子的过程中,阿森发现了一只鬣狗幼崽,牠的母亲去打猎时遗下牠。鬣狗与孟巴肯高狮群因争夺一只水牛的尸体而大打出手。弥敦收到惊喜: 孟巴肯高狮群原来藏著更多的幼狮。

programme.title: 野生动物急诊室 #4
programme.desc: 加入团队的争夺,帮助三只痛苦的小袋鼠和一只癫痫发作的考拉。与救援者乔一起爬树,将受伤的蜥蜴网起来,观看笑翠鸟的羽毛植入手术,欣赏琵鹭的新矫正鞋。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #3
programme.desc: 红毛猩猩是丛林中的建筑大师。跟随麦克斯来到婆罗洲的雨林,一起探索这种独居灵长类动物的筑巢艺术。然后见证麦克斯如何尝试逃离满布昆虫的地面,并从红毛猩猩身上学习自然界工程技巧。

programme.title: 狮群的法则 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面对雨季的挑战,这个季节让一切转为绿意盎然,同时破坏了狮子隐蔽的保护色,掩饰效果彻底失灵。观看爱因斯坦无法建立新的联系,并权衡得失,在琪萨与牠的幼崽被敌对雄狮疯眼穆迪绑走之时。

programme.title: 狮群的法则 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​迎来丰饶季节的问候,当洪水退去,大群猎物再度回到乔贝河岸边,重现成群聚集的壮观场景。观看琪萨带著幼崽尝试逃离,卡勒与汤汤则与对手搏斗激战,然后欢呼爱因斯坦终于找到配偶。

programme.title: 大猫国度 #3
programme.desc: 四头流浪雄狮组成的暴力团,正寻找可接管的狮群。他们在卢安瓜河的西岸徘徊,并已跟北方的荷里活雌狮群大打一场,现正南下进入强大的孟巴肯高狮群的地盘。孟巴肯高的雌狮群的狩猎队阻止他们接近,但她们的策略只能持续几天。

programme.title: 野生动物急诊室 #5
programme.desc: 随著诊所一同处理布里斯班洪水后的动物善后事宜,进入恢复模式。了解一只需要全天候护理的袋鼠宝宝,和一只被冲下下水道的鸻。然后看一看兽医卡琳娜耐心处理的海龟等待名单。

programme.desc: 与我们一同踏入树林与水源共同孕育新生命的湿地,再潜入保护年幼海狗的水下森林,拜访一群藏身在红树林保护区的好奇水下古怪生物,同时你还有机会一窥真实存在的沼泽怪物。

programme.title: 狮群的法则 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面对雨季的挑战,这个季节让一切转为绿意盎然,同时破坏了狮子隐蔽的保护色,掩饰效果彻底失灵。观看爱因斯坦无法建立新的联系,并权衡得失,在琪萨与牠的幼崽被敌对雄狮疯眼穆迪绑走之时。

programme.title: 狮群的法则 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​迎来丰饶季节的问候,当洪水退去,大群猎物再度回到乔贝河岸边,重现成群聚集的壮观场景。观看琪萨带著幼崽尝试逃离,卡勒与汤汤则与对手搏斗激战,然后欢呼爱因斯坦终于找到配偶。

programme.title: 动物感官世界 #2
programme.desc: 触觉能让物种感知各种物理力量所带的感觉,包括得知咬伤、感受温度变化和不同质地。一些动物对非常微弱的振动特别敏感,牠们能从中获得大量关于环境的讯息。

programme.title: 肯亚野生日记 #1
programme.desc: 尼华保育区正在努力让大象由肯雅山经过桑布鲁国家公园回到野外。他们还创造了一个大象禁区,试图恢复受损的生态系统。无线电跟踪项圈用于帮助环保学家更好地了解大象的需求,并观察牠们是否正返回栖息地。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #6
programme.desc: 从修剪整齐的稻田到野性热带雨林,湄公河是泰国东部的生命之源。一起走访河岸,看看长臂猿如何处理家庭纠纷,并暸解腹蛇如何为该区脆弱的生命网络带来威胁。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #7
programme.desc: 柬埔寨被系于湄公河的水域网络之中,因此与这条大河的关系密不可分。看看这个国家如何展现生物多样性,并见证动物族群如何在未受破坏的自然栖息地中找到秘密庇护所。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #8
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命线,尤其是在酷热难耐的旱季,宝贵的水分几乎难以寻觅。深入探索并了解各式各样能展翅飞翔的生物,无论是鸟类还是蝙蝠,牠们在缺水的漫长日子里,善加运用并精打细算管理仅有的资源,直到雨季降临、甘甜的雨水带来久违的慰藉与舒缓。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #9
programme.desc: 湄公河之旅的最后一个国家是湄公河三角洲的发源地。大量营养丰富的物质从数百里外的河流顺流而下,使此地成为越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物宝库。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #10
programme.desc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一。迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通过九条水道绵延流入南海。这些水道分割并塑造了海岸线,为各种动物创造了独特的栖息地。

programme.title: 迷忘国度 #3
programme.desc: 走进芬迪湾汹涌的水域。了解这个东岸生态系统如何维持众多生物,当中包括成千上万的海鸟,世上最快的捕食者,以及复杂的无脊椎动物网络。

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密联盟 #2
programme.desc: 喀拉哈里的动物们渴望雨水,因为牠们已经忍受了极端干旱的一年。见证象群在拼命寻找水源时的合作,邂逅帮助小猫鼬生存的奇怪保姆。

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密联盟 #3
programme.desc: 跟随到达喀拉哈里沙漠的科学家并验证一个假设: 动物合作是该地区爆发物种多样性的关键。观察他们监控行为、破译数据,并得出引人入胜的结论。

programme.title: 大猫国度 #1
programme.desc: 在卢安瓜谷,强大的孟巴肯高狮群仍有17头壮狮,但老化的雄性领导无以为继。在北方,荷里活狮群中的六只雌狮已经自给自足了三年,但没有雄性与她们交配,可能导致族群灭绝。四名年轻流浪雄狮突然的造访,似乎回应著荷里活狮群的祈祷。

programme.title: 大猫国度 #2
programme.desc: 在卢安瓜谷,荷里活狮群大难临头。流浪雄狮的侵袭使女族长阿华受了重伤。由于首领丧失能力,狩猎变得困难。在寻找狮子的过程中,阿森发现了一只鬣狗幼崽,牠的母亲去打猎时遗下牠。鬣狗与孟巴肯高狮群因争夺一只水牛的尸体而大打出手。弥敦收到惊喜: 孟巴肯高狮群原来藏著更多的幼狮。

programme.title: 大猫国度 #3
programme.desc: 四头流浪雄狮组成的暴力团,正寻找可接管的狮群。他们在卢安瓜河的西岸徘徊,并已跟北方的荷里活雌狮群大打一场,现正南下进入强大的孟巴肯高狮群的地盘。孟巴肯高的雌狮群的狩猎队阻止他们接近,但她们的策略只能持续几天。

programme.title: 野生动物急诊室 #6
programme.desc: 跟随兽医蒂姆争分夺秒地救治无尾熊艾希莉,并拜会一只需要兽医马丁额外照顾的狐蝠,因为牠多了一只手指。与兽医艾米莉一起照顾遭遇车祸的袋鼠幼宝宝,并评估牠们的生存机会,然后庆祝50只吸蜜鹦鹉重返野外。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​冲过昆士兰东南地区,在繁殖与捕蛇的季节逐步升温时,观看阿黛儿与米克迎战一条东部棕蛇,这是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同时史都与丽芙则与一条地毯蟒纠缠搏斗。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​随著春季的蛇潮展开,跟随丽芙与史都一起,他们在工地现场拦截两条为争夺交配权而决斗的公棕蛇,这是一场激烈的争斗,一场关乎交配资格的争战。退后站观,观看丹与洁丝从一条蟒蛇手中救出鸡群,而米克与阿黛儿则追捕一条失控的绿树蛇。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭于昆士兰沿海的混乱景象与喧嚣之中,杰丝勇敢面对她内心的恐惧,追逐一只攀爬至树上的蕾丝蜥蜴,而那棵树上还栖息著活跃繁忙的蜂巢。观看斯图小心翼翼地将一条被困在篱笆之间的东方褐蛇救出,并观察米克为惊慌不安的屋主捕捉那条滑溜难抓、灵活的巨蟒。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潜入狭小紧迫的空间之中,钻入温室的底部结构,并进入紧张刺激的救援现场,捕蛇人勇敢面对一条长达六英尺、极度有毒的褐蛇。随后观看斯图与莉芙将威胁到屋主宠物安全的沿海巨蟒小心搬迁至安全地点。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #5
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​冲进崭新的郊区社区,驯蛇专家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅。观看斯图与莉芙将一条东方褐蛇从工地移出,杰丝与丹将巨蟒从仓库中驱逐出去,而米克与阿黛尔则将红腹蛇赶出卧室,确保屋主生活区域的安全。

programme.title: 澳洲蛇类捕捉队: 死亡追捕 #6
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在偏远农村地产面对危险时,米克与阿黛尔勇敢无畏地应对一条激烈攻击的褐蛇。杰丝与丹小心翼翼地将巨蟒从游乐区中救出,而当一条捕鸡巨蟒在紧张危急的救援过程中压住莉芙的手时,更令人心跳加速、惊慌不已。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #4
programme.desc: 跟随麦克斯来到卢安达的森林追踪黑猩猩,他试图说服这些强壮的猴子相信他是朋友而非敌人。一起学习在丛林觅食的关键技巧,并见证黑猩猩复杂的家庭动态,包括梳理毛发和社交活动。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #5
programme.desc: 跟随麦可斯探索斯里兰卡,窥探懒熊常被误解的神秘世界。见证这种看似人畜无害、毛发蓬乱的动物,如何无畏地击退豹子,并观察牠们如何努力获取所需的营养。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #6
programme.desc: 本集带观众与豹同行,跟随这些自然界的伪装大师,隐没于斯里兰卡的丛林之中。深入了解这种强大的猫科猎手,如何完美适应岛上炎热干燥的气候,并学习牠们的追踪和猎食技巧。

programme.title: 野生动物急诊室 #6
programme.desc: 跟随兽医蒂姆争分夺秒地救治无尾熊艾希莉,并拜会一只需要兽医马丁额外照顾的狐蝠,因为牠多了一只手指。与兽医艾米莉一起照顾遭遇车祸的袋鼠幼宝宝,并评估牠们的生存机会,然后庆祝50只吸蜜鹦鹉重返野外。

programme.title: 内马尔: 巴西头号射手
programme.desc: 从山度士街头到成为巴西队头号射手,内马尔20年的历程值得载入史册。内马尔几乎在每个大洲都踢过足球,他将永远成为球坛的传说。

programme.title: 布莱德彼特: 突破好莱坞
programme.desc: 他可能是最性感的荷里活演员之一,但他的职业和个人目标比他的外表更有味道。布莱德彼特。整个荷里活首屈一指的人物之一。一个默默无闻的天才转变为超级巨星的故事。

programme.title: 汤姆汉克斯: 演无不克
programme.desc: 从出身卑微到成为有抱负的演员,再到扮演世上最具标志性和最著名的角色。他赢得了「美国好人」、「平民」和艺术游牧民的美誉。而我们都知道他……是 汤姆汉克斯。

programme.title: 内马尔: 巴西头号射手
programme.desc: 从山度士街头到成为巴西队头号射手,内马尔20年的历程值得载入史册。内马尔几乎在每个大洲都踢过足球,他将永远成为球坛的传说。

programme.title: 动物长青术 #2
programme.desc: 认识一些黄昏恋人,探索他们性长寿,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。

programme.title: 动物长青术 #3
programme.desc: 随著动物老去,如何保持领导地位?我们调查作为一个狼群年老领导者所承担的责任与挑战。

programme.title: 动物长青术 #4
programme.desc: 我们探索老年动物对构成其群体是如何不可或缺,并研究动物在其生命过程中如何学习。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #21
programme.desc: 我们今集来一场海鲜全接触。从纽约水牛城著名的鱼馔到夏威夷群岛的昂贵鱼馔,再到德克萨斯州的内陆城市,那是您最不可能找到优质海鲜的地方。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #22
programme.desc: 我们在边境城市圣地牙哥品尝美味、新鲜的海鲜,然后前往拉古纳海滩,在橙县中心品尝美味的巴黎美食。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #23
programme.desc: 参观圣费尔南多谷的纽约风酒吧,品尝美食,并在洛杉矶托伦斯品尝正宗的日本料理。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #24
programme.desc: 到访德克萨斯州的侯斯顿,尝试更上一层楼、令人垂涎欲滴的汉堡,有可能是史上最大,纽约典型的牛扒之家品尝他们精心烹制的干式熟成牛扒。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #25
programme.desc: 品尝一些精心准备的日本河粉。 然后到法国品尝我们在独特的乡村别致棕榈泉餐厅享用的美味佳肴。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #26

programme.desc: 廖崇明继续他的日本烹饪朝圣之旅,品尝一些最顶级的味噌、名古屋鸡肉和和牛,并认识了一位年届74岁的采鲍潜水员。

programme.title: 进化中的素食者 #2
programme.desc: 多元化的大厨们制作垂涎欲滴的素饺子、炸「鸡」三文治和越南「鲇鱼」;文拿寻找龙虾蘑菇并参观美国最古老的豆腐厂。

programme.title: 进化中的素食者 #3
programme.desc: 文拿探索他加拿大的「后院」,发现美味的素寿司、开心果奶油甜馅煎饼卷和薄饼;他与喜剧演员巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士厂试工。

programme.title: 进化中的素食者 #4
programme.desc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂热中,品尝了许多当地美食: 素海鲜、柠檬汁「海鲜」冷盘和经典的素食辣酱粟米饼。之后,文拿跟一位当地的奶奶制作传统的混酱。

programme.title: 进化中的素食者 #5
programme.desc: 德州中心深处是一片素食绿洲;文拿探索另类令人惊喜的德州美味素食: 炸鸡、巨大无比的饼干、排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩。

programme.title: 动物长青术 #2
programme.desc: 认识一些黄昏恋人,探索他们性长寿,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。

programme.title: 动物长青术 #3
programme.desc: 随著动物老去,如何保持领导地位?我们调查作为一个狼群年老领导者所承担的责任与挑战。

programme.title: 动物长青术 #4
programme.desc: 我们探索老年动物对构成其群体是如何不可或缺,并研究动物在其生命过程中如何学习。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天温和潮湿,对不同动物来说,是好消息,也可以是坏消息。欧洲马鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文鱼已经半年没有食物,山兔变成了显眼的白色,松鼠将自己的幼崽赶出巢穴。

programme.title: 大白鲨的秘密
programme.desc: 鲨鱼是怪物吗?还是已经被妖魔化?这部纪录片探讨大白鲨本性背后的真相。

programme.title: 创造之岛
programme.desc: 在南太平洋一个偏远群岛的丛林中,一位生物学家正尝试做著查理斯达尔文和恩斯特迈尔的未竟之事: 在新物种创造过程中捕捉进化的身影。怀艾伯特在所罗门群岛即将有一个惊人的发现,但一个危机慢慢逼近。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #1
programme.desc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生动物。冬天带来严苛的风暴、苦难和冲突,大多数动物都要为生存而战。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 现在是六月,公园沐浴在17个小时的日光之中。温暖的气温带来了丰收,但对新生儿来说,夏季很重要,因牠们要学习战斗、觅食和躲避掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿争相繁殖、鱼鹰雏鸟开展3000英里西非迁徙、三文鱼返回牠们出生的河流、极北蝰产子的季节。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天温和潮湿,对不同动物来说,是好消息,也可以是坏消息。欧洲马鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文鱼已经半年没有食物,山兔变成了显眼的白色,松鼠将自己的幼崽赶出巢穴。

programme.title: 大白鲨的秘密

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入胜的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的梦想。茱迪心爱的麂羚是时候回归大自然。例行的东非条纹羚捕捉行动发生意想不到的转折。

programme.desc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one How should I put it? Don’t miss “Cute Pet Guide”!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt has a heavyweight problem to tackle -V Kifarou, one of Flamingoland's male white rhinos, has a skin infection At Matt's surgery, he operates on a kestrel with a broken wing When wildlife rescuer Jean Thorpe arrives to collect the patient, Matt has another bundle for her, a poorly duck with suspected lead poisoning

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the West Midlands a local vet has reported serious concern for a young dog that's recently left her surgery The owners had refused to let the vets properly treat little Lola even though she had quite severe injuries Inspector Herchy Boal has been called to help track down the owners and as it's such a young puppy it's critical Herchy finds her before it's too late

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet to bring you the most hilarious clips of Budgies (and other birds) on the planet, not so much -§who's a clever boy-¨ as -§who's a funny boy-¨! Flying fails, performing Parrots and the real life angry birds -V we've assembled the very best the web has to offer, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts"nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show" These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #83
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭大卫和贾丝黛洛合体而成的贾丝大卫攻击而身受重创。贾丝大卫拥有强大的力量,即使是亚连和拉比也无法与其抗衡。众人对付这位棘手敌人时,房间开始崩塌。此时原本负伤倒下的柯洛利牵制住贾丝大卫,并催亚连等人尽快前进。

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #12
programme.desc: 在王城等待健一一行人的是公主莉莉丝。由于觐见国王需要时间,健一决定在王城一隅设置自己的房子。莉莉丝对健一召唤出的各种物品充满兴趣,并对他产生好感。两人的距离感过于亲近,被护卫视为不敬,甚至想取健一的性命,而安妮莫奈也以魔法应战!

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #13
programme.desc: 健一一行人终于迎来与国王的会面,然而却突然被命令与女魔导师梅丽莎进行御前比试,并要对抗她所召唤的下级龙。健一也召唤出挖土机,与安妮莫奈等人合力迎战,但有下级龙强烈的龙息和坚硬的皮肤阻挡,他们的攻击毫无作用!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #19
programme.desc: 守仁整理房间时发现了小时候妮可写给他的信。信上写著「给MOI:妮可永远永远都是MOI的好朋友喔」。守仁表示他将这封信贴在墙上长达五年的时间,并且每天都受到这封信的鼓励。因为今天是母亲的忌日,守仁独自一人前往扫墓。另一方面,妮可、监志、圭护、见晴及来乙木家玩的音梦从妮可口中听到了她与和现在有些不同的小时候的守仁之间的往事。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #20
programme.desc: 圭护若没有看见新月图案就无法发挥强大的力量。妮可看见圭护脸上浮现出有些落寞的表情,于是交给他一枚注入了「飞天魔法」的戒指,并表示希望他能使用。只要能灵活使用应该就能成为一种武器……于是圭护怀抱著这个想法开始进行特训。某天,音梦找正在进行秘密特训的圭护讲话。

programme.desc: 圭护若没有看见新月图案就无法发挥强大的力量。妮可看见圭护脸上浮现出有些落寞的表情,于是交给他一枚注入了「飞天魔法」的戒指,并表示希望他能使用。只要能灵活使用应该就能成为一种武器……于是圭护怀抱著这个想法开始进行特训。某天,音梦找正在进行秘密特训的圭护讲话。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #82
programme.desc: 亚连等人遭大卫和贾丝黛洛攻击,他们因戴上「骗人眼镜」被夺去正常的视觉。他们的视野充满无数的钥匙,大卫将从亚连身上抢来的钥匙扔进那些幻影钥匙堆中。之后亚连将寻找钥匙的任务交付给拉比,转身与柯洛利共同迎击敌人。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #83
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭大卫和贾丝黛洛合体而成的贾丝大卫攻击而身受重创。贾丝大卫拥有强大的力量,即使是亚连和拉比也无法与其抗衡。众人对付这位棘手敌人时,房间开始崩塌。此时原本负伤倒下的柯洛利牵制住贾丝大卫,并催亚连等人尽快前进。

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #6
programme.desc: 岛井多惠和一只妖猫生活在港口小镇。当她路过渔港时,发现有大量的鱼尸体被冲上岸,镇民担心这是「善太的诅咒」。户平善太以已故孙子的外貌制作一尊木偶后便死去,从此木偶会在夜晚四处走动,小镇上发生令人联想到木偶皮诺丘童话的异变。

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #7
programme.desc: 琴子在妖怪们的委托下前往拜访多惠。她察觉这尊一到夜晚就会随机电死大量鱼群的木偶身上寄宿著落于本地的「某异物」之力,具备与世间常理相悖的神秘力量。琴子等人立即著手计划消灭木偶,然而它身上却隐藏著一个秘密。

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #12
programme.desc: 在王城等待健一一行人的是公主莉莉丝。由于觐见国王需要时间,健一决定在王城一隅设置自己的房子。莉莉丝对健一召唤出的各种物品充满兴趣,并对他产生好感。两人的距离感过于亲近,被护卫视为不敬,甚至想取健一的性命,而安妮莫奈也以魔法应战!

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #13
programme.desc: 健一一行人终于迎来与国王的会面,然而却突然被命令与女魔导师梅丽莎进行御前比试,并要对抗她所召唤的下级龙。健一也召唤出挖土机,与安妮莫奈等人合力迎战,但有下级龙强烈的龙息和坚硬的皮肤阻挡,他们的攻击毫无作用!

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #84
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭贾丝大卫所创造的「钢铁处女」夹住后刺穿。他在逐渐模糊的意识中想起与亚连等人成为伙伴的回忆。房间正面临倒塌的危机,贾丝大卫试图逃离此处。就在此时,有一位意想不到的人物在虚幻之间出现在柯洛利面前。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #7
programme.desc: 莱利娜收到了弗丽丝答应给她的,于锡克雷特山脉召开的魔物讨伐战邀请函。依照讨伐战惯例,女性将赠送手帕给男性,男性则会将捕捉到的魔物献给女性。努尔之前从未收下任何人的手帕,也从未献上魔物给任何人。到了讨伐战当日,努尔对莱利娜提出了某项要求。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努尔将被称作山之主的魔物献给了莱利娜后,让两人的距离从原本的契约关系逐渐开始有了变化,却也让莱利娜的命运笼罩在不祥的阴影之中。薇薇安对努尔抱有好感,却连点燃神殿圣火的使命都被莱利娜夺走而怀恨在心,而此时,有一个人暗中接近她。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #10
programme.desc: B小町预定参加日本偶像节,但必须决定谁将担任中心位置,露比与MEM CYO都支持 佳奈,因为她是最棒的歌手。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #11
programme.desc: B小町终于登上舞台。人群为MEM CYO欢呼, 露比以晚期的小爱般的魅力吸引粉丝,但是奈缺乏支持…。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧蓝之海 (第一季) #7
programme.desc: 伊织等人看著杂志上介绍的宫古岛特集,对能在美丽的大海中潜水感到非常向往。然而不知为何,在时田和寿的邀请下,他们即将进行网球双打比赛!由於潜水时有两人一组行动的结伴制度,因此与托付生命的伙伴建立信赖关系是非常重要的……而这些只是表面话,实际上是想从网球社团Tinker Bell手中夺取奖金,以报伊豆春季时的仇。PaB的成员们能在比赛中胜出吗……!?

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧蓝之海 (第一季) #8
programme.desc: 冲绳集训的相关费用必须各自靠打工赚。但伊织和耕平的日薪工收入却都拿去喝酒花光了。而寿倒是很认真在打工,而且竟然还是当酒保。伊织和耕平对寿在店里展现出与平时截然不同的氛围感到困惑。之后在店长的好意下,两人也决定尝试体验酒保的工作。然而,这两个笨蛋对鸡尾酒的做法当然是一窍不通,还接二连三地调出了许多危险的酒精炸弹……。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧蓝之海 (第一季) #8
programme.desc: 冲绳集训的相关费用必须各自靠打工赚。但伊织和耕平的日薪工收入却都拿去喝酒花光了。而寿倒是很认真在打工,而且竟然还是当酒保。伊织和耕平对寿在店里展现出与平时截然不同的氛围感到困惑。之后在店长的好意下,两人也决定尝试体验酒保的工作。然而,这两个笨蛋对鸡尾酒的做法当然是一窍不通,还接二连三地调出了许多危险的酒精炸弹……。

programme.desc: 琴子在妖怪们的委托下前往拜访多惠。她察觉这尊一到夜晚就会随机电死大量鱼群的木偶身上寄宿著落于本地的「某异物」之力,具备与世间常理相悖的神秘力量。琴子等人立即著手计划消灭木偶,然而它身上却隐藏著一个秘密。

programme.title: 虚构推理 (第二季) #8
programme.desc: 除了饭店经营外还发展各种事业的音无集团会长・音无刚一要求私下和琴子会面。他的妻子曾在路上遇到劫匪,因此丧命。刚一对琴子坦承是他间接害死了妻子,时日无多的刚一希望将自己是杀人犯的事实详细告诉孩子们。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #7
programme.desc: 莱利娜收到了弗丽丝答应给她的,于锡克雷特山脉召开的魔物讨伐战邀请函。依照讨伐战惯例,女性将赠送手帕给男性,男性则会将捕捉到的魔物献给女性。努尔之前从未收下任何人的手帕,也从未献上魔物给任何人。到了讨伐战当日,努尔对莱利娜提出了某项要求。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努尔将被称作山之主的魔物献给了莱利娜后,让两人的距离从原本的契约关系逐渐开始有了变化,却也让莱利娜的命运笼罩在不祥的阴影之中。薇薇安对努尔抱有好感,却连点燃神殿圣火的使命都被莱利娜夺走而怀恨在心,而此时,有一个人暗中接近她。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #10
programme.desc: B小町预定参加日本偶像节,但必须决定谁将担任中心位置,露比与MEM CYO都支持 佳奈,因为她是最棒的歌手。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #11
programme.desc: B小町终于登上舞台。人群为MEM CYO欢呼, 露比以晚期的小爱般的魅力吸引粉丝,但是奈缺乏支持…。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #83
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭大卫和贾丝黛洛合体而成的贾丝大卫攻击而身受重创。贾丝大卫拥有强大的力量,即使是亚连和拉比也无法与其抗衡。众人对付这位棘手敌人时,房间开始崩塌。此时原本负伤倒下的柯洛利牵制住贾丝大卫,并催亚连等人尽快前进。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #85
programme.desc: 亚连等人尽管担心留下来战斗的神田和柯洛利,却相信两人必定会归队,于是加紧脚步赶路。之后他们终于抵达塔楼最高处的房间,然而帝奇和萝特早已在此等待。亚连等人保持警戒,但在帝奇轻声表示除了塔以外的地方都已崩塌殆尽后,他们掉入绝望深渊。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #9
programme.desc: 莱利娜为了圣火仪式被赋予了严苛任务,疲惫不已的她来到泉水边,也因此救起了一只溺水的鸟。但刚好在场的大神官希卡认为去救注定要死的鸟只是白费功夫,两人因此起了口角。希卡事后遍寻整个神殿,却怎么都找不到那个对自己失礼,但又令人在意不已的莱利娜。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧蓝之海 (第一季) #8
programme.desc: 冲绳集训的相关费用必须各自靠打工赚。但伊织和耕平的日薪工收入却都拿去喝酒花光了。而寿倒是很认真在打工,而且竟然还是当酒保。伊织和耕平对寿在店里展现出与平时截然不同的氛围感到困惑。之后在店长的好意下,两人也决定尝试体验酒保的工作。然而,这两个笨蛋对鸡尾酒的做法当然是一窍不通,还接二连三地调出了许多危险的酒精炸弹……。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧蓝之海 (第一季) #9
programme.desc: 为了友情(金钱),伊织再次背负起安排联谊的任务。他打算拿「国王游戏」当借口请千纱介绍她的朋友。随著奈奈华和梓也被卷入游戏中,一场各怀鬼胎的攻防战就这么开始了。不惜这么做也想要钱的伊织目前似乎仍未存够集训的费用。但他还是得凑齐潜水必要的用品,于是他为了购买器材前往潜水用品店。对伊织这些新手来说,潜水的世界还有太多他们不了解的事了。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #81
programme.desc: 亚连等人因无法辨明大卫和贾丝黛洛的能力而陷入苦战。由于两人对克劳斯怀有强烈恨意,于是将怒火发泄到他徒弟的亚连身上。他们生气的原因是克劳斯曾将多额借款推给两人偿还。亚连听闻此事后嗤之以鼻,表示自己才是因克劳斯而负债累累的最大受害者。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #82
programme.desc: 亚连等人遭大卫和贾丝黛洛攻击,他们因戴上「骗人眼镜」被夺去正常的视觉。他们的视野充满无数的钥匙,大卫将从亚连身上抢来的钥匙扔进那些幻影钥匙堆中。之后亚连将寻找钥匙的任务交付给拉比,转身与柯洛利共同迎击敌人。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #83
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭大卫和贾丝黛洛合体而成的贾丝大卫攻击而身受重创。贾丝大卫拥有强大的力量,即使是亚连和拉比也无法与其抗衡。众人对付这位棘手敌人时,房间开始崩塌。此时原本负伤倒下的柯洛利牵制住贾丝大卫,并催亚连等人尽快前进。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #84
programme.desc: 柯洛利遭贾丝大卫所创造的「钢铁处女」夹住后刺穿。他在逐渐模糊的意识中想起与亚连等人成为伙伴的回忆。房间正面临倒塌的危机,贾丝大卫试图逃离此处。就在此时,有一位意想不到的人物在虚幻之间出现在柯洛利面前。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #85
programme.desc: 亚连等人尽管担心留下来战斗的神田和柯洛利,却相信两人必定会归队,于是加紧脚步赶路。之后他们终于抵达塔楼最高处的房间,然而帝奇和萝特早已在此等待。亚连等人保持警戒,但在帝奇轻声表示除了塔以外的地方都已崩塌殆尽后,他们掉入绝望深渊。

programme.title: 世界尽头的圣骑士  #1
programme.desc: 少年威尔在边境地区的死者之街被三位不死者养育。备受他们呵护,健康成长的威尔发现此地不存在自己以外的人类。他开始思考自己在这里的原因与三人一味隐藏的秘密。但威尔本身其实也有所隐瞒。

programme.title: 世界尽头的圣骑士  #2
programme.desc: 威尔得知玛利的秘密后过了5年的岁月,威尔成长为13岁。三人授课内容的难度也越来越高,不过他仍不服输地学习。某天在教学时间布拉德命令威尔从废墟都市的地下街脱逃。威尔拼命打倒魔物,前往出口,在半路却因感受到异样的杀气而驻足,他所看到的是――

programme.title: 世界尽头的圣骑士  #3
programme.desc: 15岁的威尔迎来与布拉德认真对打,一较高下的成人仪式。另一方面,古斯却拜托他故意输掉这场对决。威尔迟迟无法确认在废墟都市时古斯释放杀气的真意,就这么面临了布拉德的考验。

programme.title: 世界尽头的圣骑士  #4
programme.desc: 突然现身的不死之神斯塔古内特试图带走布拉德与玛利,古斯在千钧一发之际救下他们。众人才刚放下心,就有一道黑雾划开了古斯的胸口。斯塔古内特大胆地朝著呆立不动的威尔微笑,并道出一切都是多亏了他。

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #11
programme.desc: 为了探寻安妮莫奈魔力的根源,健一开始搜集她母亲的情报。但安妮莫奈并不感兴趣,她的身体也发生变化…另一方面,马洛来到健一的家中,他的目的是重建子爵家的财政并除掉索加拉姆。而健一也有一件必须告诉他的事情。

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #12
programme.desc: 在王城等待健一一行人的是公主莉莉丝。由于觐见国王需要时间,健一决定在王城一隅设置自己的房子。莉莉丝对健一召唤出的各种物品充满兴趣,并对他产生好感。两人的距离感过于亲近,被护卫视为不敬,甚至想取健一的性命,而安妮莫奈也以魔法应战!

programme.title: 中年男的异世界网购生活 #13
programme.desc: 健一一行人终于迎来与国王的会面,然而却突然被命令与女魔导师梅丽莎进行御前比试,并要对抗她所召唤的下级龙。健一也召唤出挖土机,与安妮莫奈等人合力迎战,但有下级龙强烈的龙息和坚硬的皮肤阻挡,他们的攻击毫无作用!

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #8
programme.desc: 努尔将被称作山之主的魔物献给了莱利娜后,让两人的距离从原本的契约关系逐渐开始有了变化,却也让莱利娜的命运笼罩在不祥的阴影之中。薇薇安对努尔抱有好感,却连点燃神殿圣火的使命都被莱利娜夺走而怀恨在心,而此时,有一个人暗中接近她。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #9
programme.desc: 莱利娜为了圣火仪式被赋予了严苛任务,疲惫不已的她来到泉水边,也因此救起了一只溺水的鸟。但刚好在场的大神官希卡认为去救注定要死的鸟只是白费功夫,两人因此起了口角。希卡事后遍寻整个神殿,却怎么都找不到那个对自己失礼,但又令人在意不已的莱利娜。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #81
programme.desc: 亚连等人因无法辨明大卫和贾丝黛洛的能力而陷入苦战。由于两人对克劳斯怀有强烈恨意,于是将怒火发泄到他徒弟的亚连身上。他们生气的原因是克劳斯曾将多额借款推给两人偿还。亚连听闻此事后嗤之以鼻,表示自己才是因克劳斯而负债累累的最大受害者。

programme.title: 驱魔少年 #82
programme.desc: 亚连等人遭大卫和贾丝黛洛攻击,他们因戴上「骗人眼镜」被夺去正常的视觉。他们的视野充满无数的钥匙,大卫将从亚连身上抢来的钥匙扔进那些幻影钥匙堆中。之后亚连将寻找钥匙的任务交付给拉比,转身与柯洛利共同迎击敌人。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #18
programme.desc: 妮可和久久换上巫女服,在伽罗的父亲担任宫司的神社帮忙。妮可在帮忙之余,顺便对用来制作纸垂的纸施展「动画剪」的魔法,做出了会动的纸猫。而伽罗也立刻做了一只鸟想让它在天上飞,结果却因为剪得不够好而飞不起来……。然而,这张纸因为伽罗剪纸技术太糟导致形状像是「式神」,并疑似因此创造出了不会消失的生命……!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #19
programme.desc: 守仁整理房间时发现了小时候妮可写给他的信。信上写著「给MOI:妮可永远永远都是MOI的好朋友喔」。守仁表示他将这封信贴在墙上长达五年的时间,并且每天都受到这封信的鼓励。因为今天是母亲的忌日,守仁独自一人前往扫墓。另一方面,妮可、监志、圭护、见晴及来乙木家玩的音梦从妮可口中听到了她与和现在有些不同的小时候的守仁之间的往事。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #20
programme.desc: 圭护若没有看见新月图案就无法发挥强大的力量。妮可看见圭护脸上浮现出有些落寞的表情,于是交给他一枚注入了「飞天魔法」的戒指,并表示希望他能使用。只要能灵活使用应该就能成为一种武器……于是圭护怀抱著这个想法开始进行特训。某天,音梦找正在进行秘密特训的圭护讲话。

programme.desc: 亚连等人因无法辨明大卫和贾丝黛洛的能力而陷入苦战。由于两人对克劳斯怀有强烈恨意,于是将怒火发泄到他徒弟的亚连身上。他们生气的原因是克劳斯曾将多额借款推给两人偿还。亚连听闻此事后嗤之以鼻,表示自己才是因克劳斯而负债累累的最大受害者。

programme.title: 家里蹲吸血姬的郁闷 #1
programme.desc: 黛拉可玛莉岗德森布莱德诞生在姆尔纳特帝国贵族世家,却天天享受家里蹲生活。某天,薇儿海丝出现在她面前,自称是她的专属女仆并告知可玛莉已经被任命为「七红天大将军」。七红天的必备条件是强大的实力,但可玛莉是个身为吸血鬼却喝不了血的娇弱少女。

programme.title: 家里蹲吸血姬的郁闷 #2
programme.desc: 可玛莉突然被任命为七红天,仍然靠运气与虚张声势,漂亮地击退了想要以下犯上的部下,初次征战也夺下胜利,还顺利与一群怪人部下开完会,也获得了骑兽,心情非常愉悦。而部下约翰却突然提出决斗。在众目睽睽之下,可玛莉该如何在决斗展现七红天的威严?

programme.title: 家里蹲吸血姬的郁闷 #3
programme.desc: 透过薇儿的策略,可玛莉将约翰打得体无完肤。因此在部下之间掀起可玛莉旋风,与他国的战争也是百战百胜。但是在庆功宴出现了一名少女。她的名字是米莉桑德,过去与可玛莉曾结下各种恩怨。米莉桑德突然袭击,让可玛莉完全反应不过来……

programme.title: 家里蹲吸血姬的郁闷 #4
programme.desc: 为了救出遭掳的薇儿,可玛莉独自去见米莉桑德。面对可玛莉,米莉桑德开始讲起三年前发生在学院的那起事件的真相。可玛莉听到米莉桑德充满憎恶与杀意的话语,她下定决心战斗。三年前就读同一间学院,却踏上截然不同的道路的两人,如今将再次交锋!

programme.desc: 莱利娜为了圣火仪式被赋予了严苛任务,疲惫不已的她来到泉水边,也因此救起了一只溺水的鸟。但刚好在场的大神官希卡认为去救注定要死的鸟只是白费功夫,两人因此起了口角。希卡事后遍寻整个神殿,却怎么都找不到那个对自己失礼,但又令人在意不已的莱利娜。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #18
programme.desc: 妮可和久久换上巫女服,在伽罗的父亲担任宫司的神社帮忙。妮可在帮忙之余,顺便对用来制作纸垂的纸施展「动画剪」的魔法,做出了会动的纸猫。而伽罗也立刻做了一只鸟想让它在天上飞,结果却因为剪得不够好而飞不起来……。然而,这张纸因为伽罗剪纸技术太糟导致形状像是「式神」,并疑似因此创造出了不会消失的生命……!

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #19
programme.desc: 守仁整理房间时发现了小时候妮可写给他的信。信上写著「给MOI:妮可永远永远都是MOI的好朋友喔」。守仁表示他将这封信贴在墙上长达五年的时间,并且每天都受到这封信的鼓励。因为今天是母亲的忌日,守仁独自一人前往扫墓。另一方面,妮可、监志、圭护、见晴及来乙木家玩的音梦从妮可口中听到了她与和现在有些不同的小时候的守仁之间的往事。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #20
programme.desc: 圭护若没有看见新月图案就无法发挥强大的力量。妮可看见圭护脸上浮现出有些落寞的表情,于是交给他一枚注入了「飞天魔法」的戒指,并表示希望他能使用。只要能灵活使用应该就能成为一种武器……于是圭护怀抱著这个想法开始进行特训。某天,音梦找正在进行秘密特训的圭护讲话。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一个人,都需要一个温暖、安全,可以得到庇护的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以与挚爱天家相聚也并非绝对,突如起来的天灾,毫无先兆的顽疾,极速致命的意外,误入歧途的决定,足以令一个家毁于一旦。 第四辑《如果还有明天》搜罗多个见证故事,有50年代经典歌曲《情人的眼泪》原唱者潘秀琼、《阴阳路》编剧、狗仔队之父、被癌症缠扰的中国商人…… 他们的家都曾经陷入崩溃边缘,明天的路更是举步为艰,但在绝望边缘他们遇见上帝,重新发现有一个「家」是永远不被摧毁、不会改变,可以成为他们永恒的避难所。

programme.title: 主日讲坛-中国基督教播道会同福堂
programme.desc: 中国基督教播道会同福堂 讲题:你的时间用在那里? 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

programme.title: 专题讲座:张路加牧师宣教培灵系列
programme.desc: 华人福音工作是现今最大的禾场,我们需要怎样的装备,将福音的种子带到华人当中?就让拥有丰富牧会经验的张路加牧师,教大家好好装备,在福音的道路上奔跑吧。

programme.title: 喜乐婆婆会客室

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 铁证待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之铁证待判》继续以游历的方式,走进荷兰、土耳其、约旦、敍利亚,涉及接近50个地点,超过30个已经发生嘅神迹预言、传奇故事,以考古和实证,重新解构连科学都不能解释的千古谜团。 历年来有无数的考古学家和世界知名的纪录片频道,为了解开上帝藉著摩西施行神迹分割红海这个历史迷团,他们都不惜花上大量的财力物力,研发新科技,要到红海的海底寻找历史证据。这集创世电视会直撀约旦,踏足每一处地方,搜罗各种铁证,带你经历摩西如何施行神迹分割红海,从埃及法老王手中,带领以色列人平安走过红海,离开埃及。

programme.desc: 何伟强牧师从婚姻中遇到的不同课题,包括理财、沟通、姻亲关系、性爱……助你从《圣经》中了解处理方法,你经营一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 属灵教室:刘锐光牧师-罗马书
programme.desc: 曾担任香港海外神学院院长12年,在香港、菲律宾和美国洛杉矶有40年牧会经验的刘锐光牧师,将会深入浅出讲解一个关乎基督教信仰核心的经卷─《罗马书》与今日信徒的关系。

programme.title: 喜乐婆婆会客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子乔妈,人称「喜乐婆婆」,一生经历操练出一套喜乐心得,她更请来一众嘉宾好友,分享人生中大小风浪,靠著的是同出一辙的喜乐秘诀,在节目中娓娓道出那份属天的快乐。

programme.title: 地球大神秘
programme.desc: 从世界各地搜集到数以百计奇异事物内容,都是无法以一般人接受的观点加以解释,除非这个世界在科学理论上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下华人唱出好诗歌大赛》大赛
programme.desc: 由影音使团、香港福音盛会、华福会香港区委会、以勒基金主办,创世电视首届「天下华人唱出好诗歌」大赛,冠军即将诞生。世上最美的声音,是生命重生的声音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位参加者,一年训练、成长、比并、同行,要成为祝福城市的好声音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一个人,都需要一个温暖、安全,可以得到庇护的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以与挚爱天家相聚也并非绝对,突如起来的天灾,毫无先兆的顽疾,极速致命的意外,误入歧途的决定,足以令一个家毁于一旦。 第四辑《如果还有明天》搜罗多个见证故事,有50年代经典歌曲《情人的眼泪》原唱者潘秀琼、《阴阳路》编剧、狗仔队之父、被癌症缠扰的中国商人…… 他们的家都曾经陷入崩溃边缘,明天的路更是举步为艰,但在绝望边缘他们遇见上帝,重新发现有一个「家」是永远不被摧毁、不会改变,可以成为他们永恒的避难所。

programme.title: 主日讲坛-中国基督教播道会同福堂
programme.desc: 中国基督教播道会同福堂 讲题:你的时间用在那里? 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

programme.title: 麦希真牧师 末了的话 坚稳的根基

阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 煎鱼最怕黏镬，容易烧焦之余，卖相亦大打折扣！要减少鱼腥味，又有甚么要点？鼎爷传授「豉汁煎封鲳鱼」的窍门，还会讲解鹰鲳与白鲳的分别。简单的家常小炒，亦讲求不少下厨技巧。鼎爷奉上香嫩可口的「鸡丝炒粉丝」，炒合前更特意把粉丝放进鸡汤浸软，粉丝味道得以大大提升！鼎爷及后以巧手将原只鸡去骨并加入丰富配料，再把鸡放入猪肚内，炖煮成一道功夫菜「悟能怀凤胎」。阿谭急不及待品尝鼎爷「手势」，究竟有多滋味？

programme.title: 汇丰呈献：英雄召集：点解电竞系电竞粤
programme.desc: 电竞运动热潮席卷全球！戴祖仪、曾展望、叶蒨文、林俊其、吴俊峰、曾文心、吴文懿等「电竞星团」成员，联同电竞界知名评述「老星」主持的前奏节目《英雄召集：点解电竞系电竞》，会轻松有趣地分享相关知识与资讯，让观众做好准备，迎接即将陆续上演的精彩电竞赛事！

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 免疫及过敏病科医生指食物过敏主要受后天因素影响，更提到有研究发现如能尽早让婴儿接触不同食物，引发过敏机会就较低。医生述说八大致敏食物，又提醒小麦易被忽略，为甚么？除了诊治资讯，医生还带来应对过敏的保护策略。为推动伤健共融，著名舞蹈家成立团体「舞蹈天使」，让不同残障人士亦可感受舞蹈的魅力。创办人到临，分享学员习舞后的转变，更难忘一次与学员在雨中共舞的演出。「睇𩠌食饭」，傅季馨师傅示范「咖哩烩牛脷」。

programme.title: 长命不老粤
programme.desc: 手机不离身的吴业坤近日「眼蒙」兼「耳聋」，疑患耳目失灵症。眼科医生细说手机所释蓝光对眼睛的影响；许文轩竟被验出患上干眼症！坤哥试戴日本大热的视力眼罩来个小测试，神奇地一秒变「光明」？副社长麦美恩指导侦探们与坤哥做鬼脸式眼部瑜伽，皮肤科医生还带来双眼保持紧致的贴士。黄庭锋到广州亲试采耳，并认识像音叉般的独特工具。众人又体验悠久的「鸣天鼓」养生法，感觉如何？此外，中医师另会教授可预防口臭的牙龈按摩法。

programme.title: 乘胜狙击#13粤PG
programme.desc: 冠一想离开伤心地，向骏升提出辞职。柏义被调往管理酒店，骏升指此举是保护曦昕，月华则认为他有可能破坏一对真心相爱的恋人。冠一收骏升来电，邀他参与赌王与牌王对决，冠一最终助骏升大胜。骏升以高薪挽留他，冠一仍坚持离开。柏义决定向曦昕解释清楚，修补两人关系，却遭冠一急电叫停，直指骏升之前所说的全是谎言。柏义带曦昕离家出走时，遇意外连人带车堕海……

programme.title: 忍者乱太郎粤日
programme.desc: 五年级生与六年级生的比试进入白热阶段，扮演被抓那方的小丸与新丁已相继被擒，至于乱太郎则趁著混乱闯进后后山，希望能避开一众来势汹汹的前辈。这场后辈与前辈之战，胜利将会花落谁家？

programme.title: Hands Up粤 及 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」环节，在进行核心训练中一个撑地并以膝盖碰手肘的动作时，Tiffany姐姐因膝盖未能触碰手肘向教练求助，教练有何改善指导？稍作休息后，踏入平衡训练时间。某个动作，学员撑地同时抬起左手与右脚，要保持平衡却颇具挑战。教练随即建议改为同时抬起左手与左脚，但有学员反觉得更难掌握。另外，节目将带来 AI生成动画《林中小屋》的下半部，樵夫的三女在森林中会有何遭遇？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 今天是乐园学园的家长观课日，阳葵的父母与妹妹阳彩全家到齐，还很早就来到校内参观。就在这时，阳彩与赶上学的小学生游真碰过正著，事后发现自己丢失了与美月同款的唇膏，令她整天都在愁眉苦脸。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝粤
programme.desc: 香港首间中医医院将于十二月中投入服务，新闻掏宝重温1995年专题，当时政府尚未正式立法规管中药和中医注册，市民看中医有何保障？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤

programme.desc: 两位时事评论员屈颖妍、杨立门，同观众论尽天下事、国家事、香港事；大事小事，开门见山、言无不尽，《有理说得清》！

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 元朗某冰室的肉饼饭因社交平台的「洗版式」留言爆红，摄制队向食客一探相关热潮，网络专家亦推测贴文爆红的理由。节目曾报道翠屏邨有二手公屋买家发现单位漏水，原来同类事件不只一单！再有新迁入住户投诉厨房与厕所漏水，纵获房署回复指楼上住户已完成修复，问题却依旧。事主因装修期延误，再加上旧公屋即将要交还而倍感徬徨。《新闻女王2》踏入结局篇，监制率众演员到商场宣传，送上花絮。另带来可助改善关节及肩颈痛的资讯。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之开心速递#2700粤

programme.desc: 有鱼受晓春所托教小朋友唱歌，回来时听到有人提到蔓君前男友，心头一酸。林娜受众人鼓励，决定重开直播。四平夫妇到云苗村探望之遥和红豆，红豆承诺会好好对之遥。凤姨为谢强出狱一事担忧不已，之遥劝她积极面对。

programme.desc: (大结局)欢喜与德信各自进行对「乌兹尔国」的洗黑钱计划，德信竟设计将欢喜的黑钱尽数偷去，欢喜因失去大批黑钱而陷入被国际黑钱客户追杀的危机。德信以为赢尽欢喜，怎料黄雀在后，有人暗中将德信的黑钱偷走，令德信身陷险境。嘉莉被捉，德信被迫现身出手救人。德信寻回黑钱之时，欢喜忽然出现，卓凯亦同时赶到来，结果变成三雄持枪对峙局面……

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 能预防大肠瘜肉，就可大大减低患大肠癌风险，但如何做到？瘜肉无病征，外科医生提议可先进行大便隐血作初步测试，继而接受大肠镜检查，并达致「一边检查，一边切除」。有特殊学习需要的小朋友，一般难以表达自己，「表达艺术治疗」提供一个非语言的表达途径，让孩子在过程中建立自信和自主性；表达艺术治疗师以实例作示范，并细谈令其印象深刻的个案。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，Annie炮制一道新疆菜「大盘鸡」，香辣惹味。

programme.title: 长命不老粤
programme.desc: 不少都市人有肾虚毛病，肾气强原来是抗衰老的灵丹，逆龄侦探遂前赴台湾寻访补肾食材的不老良方！黑心水饺、黑麻面可强肾，人气美食蚵仔煎更有意想不到的营养成分？中医师又怎看蚵仔补肾的说法？嘉宾艾粒两子试做仰卧抬臀，飞燕点水动作，可有强腰效用？众人猜猜不同水果、果汁的补肾功效，由营养师揭晓答案。许文轩、邓佩仪到肇庆品尝巴戟宴，对女士养生竟有莫大疗效，惟要留意药材服食剂量。面部皱纹分动态纹与静态纹，如何区别？

programme.title: 乘胜狙击#14粤PG
programme.desc: 林磊把罪证抢过来，令冠一受伤。骏升在曦昕面前承认杀人，曦昕决定离家出走。冠一陪柔紫应诊时碰见其西及正花，其西声称正花快将生儿育女，柔紫怕冠一伤心，出言安慰。曦昕认为柏义重视兄弟情多于爱情，柏义重申对她并无欺骗。有杂志揭露冠一身世，正花得知后约见冠一，但冠一衷心祝福她与兆良，希望正花将他忘记。冠一获余老板赏识，猜测是由他向杂志提供资料，以打击骏升，怎料背后策划者竟是记者夏美诗……

programme.title: 阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 外出选购陈村粉后，鼎爷坐镇「煮场」炮制「花蟹鸡油陈村粉」。陈村粉爽口弹牙之余，还吸收了蟹肉的鲜味与鸡油的芳香，让过往不太爱吃陈村粉的阿谭另眼相看！其后，鼎爷采用京葱、大头菜等「重口味」配料腌鸡，再以焖、焗方式，煮出皮脆肉嫩的「京葱烧鸡」。焖煮烧鸡时，有甚么需要注意？鼎爷得悉阿谭最近睡眠质素欠佳，贴心搜购牛蒡、腰果等健康食材，端上一道「宁神安睡汤」。他还会示范从莲蓬取出莲子，并去壳、去心的技巧。

programme.title: 闺密教煮粤
programme.desc: 方中信、袁伟豪、吴家乐品尝Jade呈现的圣诞大餐「大葱薯仔汤」、「圣诞烤火鸡」、「鲜果挞」，聊聊令他们着迷的电单车，谈谈牵动他们神经的女子。为人父者还分享对子女拍拖的态度，此话题侧田竟也有发言权？

programme.title: 区区开伙粤
programme.desc: 芝士是邪恶美食之选，在佐敦，芝士食法多多，新主持谭玉瑛带大家发掘，还有甚么最邪恶推介？佐敦区抵食之选，随时一蚊鸡就可有一碟美食！陈自瑶介绍四家专一的餐厅，鲸吞法式三文治、广东卤水、海胆及火锅配料。

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 中信银行(国际) 外汇交易平台呈献:环球新闻档案粤
手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 印度阿兰穆拉的工匠, 抗绝现代化技术, 以传统技术用金属造镜,因为他们相信没有透过折射所反映的影像才是最真实

programme.title: 排档寻情味粤英
programme.desc: 走进新加坡不同世代小贩的生活，感受他们之间的关爱、争吵以及他们对彼此坚定不移的支持。

programme.title: 西葡潮什么粤
programme.desc: 芷珮到访葡萄牙中部小镇阿罗卡(Arouca)，住进牧场酒店，一尝当农夫滋味，亲亲不同品种的动物，尽情享受原始田园之美。返回波尔图，玩转海陆空之旅。芷珮徒步攀登地标拱桥，大胆踏足距离运河65米高的桥顶看风景。期间畅饮一杯波特酒，「坚离地」非凡享受！参观当地「材料银行」别富趣味，室内装潢用品款式应有尽有，可有助芷珮为家居注入葡国风情的灵感？意犹未尽，她再走进手制特色瓷砖店，参与手绘独特瓷砖的工作坊。

programme.title: 玩转香港日与夜粤
programme.desc: 朱智贤、周奕玮、张惠雅、王歌慧展开九龙东的两日一夜拍照「打卡」之旅，穿梭鲤鱼门的灯塔与石矿场、登上油塘的魔鬼山顶，又置身牛头角的「志明桥」，无际海岸、碉堡遗迹、电影场景尽收镜头底下！四人还登上酒店高层，遥望维港醉人夜色。九龙东厂厦林立，不少已变身休憩场所、食肆或工作坊。主持们品尝法国盛宴，又走进路旁酒吧轻谈浅酌，悠闲写意！众人还学制甜品香枧、月球灯、音乐座等精致浪漫手作，添加非一般的艺术气质。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 谈到曱甴，谷主们都有不愉快经历，滢仴坦言更曾因与牠「亲密接触」而崩溃大哭。虽然拍档们一致反对，汛文指曱甴也有好的一面，理据如何？汛文整理了曱甴的身体特质，也间接解释为何牠拥有令不少人讨厌的顽强生命力，如即使头与身体分离，曱甴仍可存活数天。不少人会害怕曱甴飞向自己，这或许只是因为牠失控？汛文又提到曱甴其实喜爱干净。谷主们亦尝试讨论曱甴若在世上灭绝的利与弊，并带来防范牠们出没的贴士。

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 辣椒掌门人粤英
programme.desc: 所有辣椒都有独特的个性，无论它们原产于埃斯佩莱特、法国、韩国或西印度群岛，即使它们看起来很相似，但每种都有独特的味道和效力。从印度到泰国，厨师们透露了激发食物浓郁芳香的秘诀。

programme.title: 全城一叮粤
programme.desc: 全城艺员挑战一叮，力争发光发亮！火辣拍档黄滢仴、吴兆麟带来结合跳舞、戏剧、小提琴元素的表演，高难度旋转舞步技惊四座。刘芷玲青春甜美，冀以跳唱向家人证明没入错行，惟观众似乎不受落。坚毅追梦故事，能否打动嘉宾启动「复活之叮」？梁允瑜、王嘉慧、莫韵𫍰的舞姿被评似鱿鱼，兼摆甫士多过跳舞！嘉宾激烈讨论下，Bob躺着也中箭……擅长街舞的孖八将戏剧融入舞蹈，呈献实力和娱乐兼备的项目。他还获妻女到场支持，好有爱！

programme.title: 你想减压粤
programme.desc: 黎耀祥坦言首夺「视帝」是演艺人生最感压力之时，要舒压，他不听广东歌、不看自己演出的剧集，有何特别原因？祥仔为《杀手》操肌，爱吃的他如何平衡美食与锻练，以免负上过重压力？透过皮肤与外力接触，可令脑部产生催产素，增添安全感，甚至有助止痛。按摩是其中一个减压方法，可会越大力、时间越长就越好？有说按摩后不应即时洗澡、睡觉及喝水，孰真熟假？还有专家讲解按摩四大手法的适用情况，以及中医师介绍可舒缓头痛的穴位。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 奇妙的动物之动物新纪录粤普

programme.title: 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 《成语动画廊》以动画手法解说汉语成语的教育片，通过趣味浓厚的动画，让大家分享中国文化的独有宝藏。

programme.title: 科学×冒险 绝境求生手册粤日
programme.desc: 绝境求生专家智悟在凯伊的照应下，与皮皮、米奇和金宝一起到滑雪场游玩。前往民宿途中，汽车竟耗尽燃油，令智悟一行要冒雪抵达民宿。民宿由能源研究所前研究员沈武经营，他对能源节约甚为唠叨，令智悟等人无所适从。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子一家今天吃寿喜烧，但碰巧鸡蛋卖光，结果妈妈找到鹌鹑蛋代替。鹌鹑蛋那份美味，令小丸子对鹌鹑产生兴趣。当知道鹌鹑几乎每天都会生蛋，小丸子更有意饲养鹌鹑，让自己每天都有新鲜的鹌鹑蛋吃。

programme.title: 中国建设银行(亚洲)呈献：带阿姐看世界粤
programme.desc: 观众对「阿姐」汪明荃的印象，往往停留在其事业成就上，较少有机会了解她丰富多彩的性格和日常喜好。《带阿姐看世界》正好是一个契机，借着不同的「地胆」艺员陪阿姐外游，让观众透过各式行程，更全面地认识这位魅力焕发的全能艺人。周嘉洛带阿姐到留学的澳洲阿德莱德，品味其慢活生活，放松悠然；阮浩棕则偕同阿姐赴摩洛哥影尽靓相。阿姐压轴还会与罗家英夫妻同行，温馨共游不丹。

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 健美运动是力与美的结合，几名运动员细谈项目在香港的发展，并致力推广到大学校园。全运会、残特奥会举行期间，义工们各司其职地提供支援，个中有何得着？另会聚焦残特奥会的港队战报。WTT总决赛召集世界乒乓精英，展开男单、女单、混双比拼，战况有多激烈？香港壁球公开赛决赛于主题公园门前举行，两位埃及球手称王封后。港九区D1学界足球决赛，圣若瑟书院、拔萃男书院上演宿敌对垒。沙田区小学藉电竞单车赛，分享运动乐趣。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤 及 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 中信股份呈献：财经透视粤
programme.desc: 《财经透视》紧贴大市，回顾每周港股走势外，并关注楼市状况，透过业界人士专访、市场分析等，深入浅出探讨本港、国际财经金融热门话题，更以专题形式报道不同行业发展面对的问题。

programme.title: 新鲜人#17粤PG
programme.desc: 家辉欲请庇护工场的精神病康复者做装修，遭毗邻歧视，幸定中心存正义无异议。阮盈被文生捉回家，求DY带信给家谦。家谦发现韦文曾为自己的曲填词，不无感动，欲相约向她道谢，惜收到DY带来的信，阮盈竟要求与家谦私奔。家谦及时阻止阮盈偷走，并说服文生让他带阮盈离开一晚，家谦终劝服她到美国医病。DY被文生斥责曾将阮盈的信给家谦，差点被革辞，DY找家谦出气。佳君、家辉虽再次见面，但关系仍未好转。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 玩转香港日与夜粤
programme.desc: 朱智贤、周奕玮、张惠雅、王歌慧展开九龙东的两日一夜拍照「打卡」之旅，穿梭鲤鱼门的灯塔与石矿场、登上油塘的魔鬼山顶，又置身牛头角的「志明桥」，无际海岸、碉堡遗迹、电影场景尽收镜头底下！四人还登上酒店高层，遥望维港醉人夜色。九龙东厂厦林立，不少已变身休憩场所、食肆或工作坊。主持们品尝法国盛宴，又走进路旁酒吧轻谈浅酌，悠闲写意！众人还学制甜品香枧、月球灯、音乐座等精致浪漫手作，添加非一般的艺术气质。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 谈到曱甴，谷主们都有不愉快经历，滢仴坦言更曾因与牠「亲密接触」而崩溃大哭。虽然拍档们一致反对，汛文指曱甴也有好的一面，理据如何？汛文整理了曱甴的身体特质，也间接解释为何牠拥有令不少人讨厌的顽强生命力，如即使头与身体分离，曱甴仍可存活数天。不少人会害怕曱甴飞向自己，这或许只是因为牠失控？汛文又提到曱甴其实喜爱干净。谷主们亦尝试讨论曱甴若在世上灭绝的利与弊，并带来防范牠们出没的贴士。

programme.title: 全城一叮粤
programme.desc: 全城艺员挑战一叮，力争发光发亮！火辣拍档黄滢仴、吴兆麟带来结合跳舞、戏剧、小提琴元素的表演，高难度旋转舞步技惊四座。刘芷玲青春甜美，冀以跳唱向家人证明没入错行，惟观众似乎不受落。坚毅追梦故事，能否打动嘉宾启动「复活之叮」？梁允瑜、王嘉慧、莫韵𫍰的舞姿被评似鱿鱼，兼摆甫士多过跳舞！嘉宾激烈讨论下，Bob躺着也中箭……擅长街舞的孖八将戏剧融入舞蹈，呈献实力和娱乐兼备的项目。他还获妻女到场支持，好有爱！

programme.title: 你想减压粤
programme.desc: 黎耀祥坦言首夺「视帝」是演艺人生最感压力之时，要舒压，他不听广东歌、不看自己演出的剧集，有何特别原因？祥仔为《杀手》操肌，爱吃的他如何平衡美食与锻练，以免负上过重压力？透过皮肤与外力接触，可令脑部产生催产素，增添安全感，甚至有助止痛。按摩是其中一个减压方法，可会越大力、时间越长就越好？有说按摩后不应即时洗澡、睡觉及喝水，孰真熟假？还有专家讲解按摩四大手法的适用情况，以及中医师介绍可舒缓头痛的穴位。

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 印度阿兰穆拉的工匠, 抗绝现代化技术, 以传统技术用金属造镜,因为他们相信没有透过折射所反映的影像才是最真实

programme.title: 排档寻情味粤英
programme.desc: 走进新加坡不同世代小贩的生活，感受他们之间的关爱、争吵以及他们对彼此坚定不移的支持。

programme.title: 我的鲁蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人气英剧／鲁蛇舅舅Ｘ强迫症外甥温馨爆笑的家庭喜剧】由《虽然是精神病但没关系》的自闭症哥哥吴正世，首次担任男主角，在选秀节目中获胜的他，本该朝歌手梦前进，不料积蓄突然遭朋友骗光，从此一蹶不振，成为无业游名。某天因为姊姊与家暴丈夫离婚，而开始照顾起强迫症的外甥，过程中两人总是不断斗嘴，关系相爱又相杀，而他也从中找回责任感，成为外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力妈搭配毒舌女母女笑闹同居火花不断】一个是凡事冲动、毫无对策的妈妈，一个是洒脱率性、走自己路的女儿。原本就像陌生人一样的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，鸡飞狗跳成为日常。从降职的糗事、误会的桃色风波，到接连不断的麻烦事件，她们在斗嘴中暗暗守护彼此。越是嫌弃对方，越是离不开对方——这场「陌生人同居记」，意外写下母女间最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴莲小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳时空穿越竟重逢前世伴侣】韩国狗血教母林成汉2023年全新力作！朝鲜时代的杜榴莲，虽嫁给丈夫朴一帅，但内心真正爱的是仆人石铁，碍于身分地位的落差，榴莲与石铁始终只能维持主仆关系，石铁更是遭婆婆痛下杀手。榴莲和石铁的儿子朴言，对金素贮一见钟情，两人马上结为夫妻，然而朴言骤然离世，伤痛欲绝的婆媳俩人，竟在月蚀之夜穿越到了现代，并在丹家别墅中再次见到了曾经的爱人、丈夫，在这一世中他们会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.title: 红色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母抛家嫁富豪弃子重生只为揭穿母亲真面目】一段因爱与欲望而撕裂的亲情，点燃了跨越二十年的复仇烈火。年轻时的熙琼为追逐荣华，狠心抛夫弃子，投入旧情人赫相怀抱，却一步步被权力与野心吞噬。她的女儿珍玛在父亲离世、母亲弃养的阴影下成长，怀著深深怨恨潜入熙琼身边，以设计师与「继孙女」的身分逐步揭穿母亲的虚伪面具。母女之间爱恨交织，真相与谎言、亲情与仇恨轮番交锋，最终将迎来一场足以摧毁一切的命运对决。

programme.title: 我把社长解锁了
programme.desc: 【人气网漫改编，影帝朴星雄解密手机AI的技术奇幻职场剧！】国内市占率最高的科技公司创办人天才CEO金成柱，因突发事件被杀手追杀成了谋杀案受害者，灵魂尚未离开人世而换个方式存活在刚大学毕业出社会朴仁成的手机内。为找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO开始两人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-儿子的战争
programme.desc: 【俞承豪为父申冤，朴敏英成为他正义路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇拥有过目不忘的记忆力，为了替被诬陷为杀人犯的父亲申冤成为了律师，与权势贪腐正面对抗。与坚守正义的检察官李仁雅，从质疑到并肩作战，成为振宇最坚强的后盾。就在逐步逼近真相时，却发现自己正逐渐失去记忆。他们携手在权力夹缝中拚搏，在时间与遗忘赛跑，只为守护真相与心中那份信念与爱。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道总裁《飞狐外传》林雨申恋上俏邻居《光芒》蔡文静！】吴忧因车祸意外放男友鸽子惨遭分手，而同样在这场车祸中丧命的是雅曼生物科技总裁何西亚的未婚妻陆芸。吴忧分手后寄情于工作，投入新职场认识了陆芸的妹妹陆蔓，成为了闺蜜。在公事上与何西亚有了合作，不打不相识的这对欢喜冤家，好不容易发展成为恋人,此时发现陆芸在他们之间串连起来的缘分…

programme.title: 逆转女王
programme.desc: 【经典韩剧《贤内助女王》姊妹作】黄泰熙原是高薪的开发组长，但为了追求幸福家庭，她选择与新同事奉俊秀结婚。然而她的决定，却让她被信任的女上司赶出公司，只能在家当贤内助。五年后，泰熙感到现实生活的沉重，决定重返职场。在公司她遇见了具勇植，一位支持她的本部长。泰熙在勇植的鼓励下展现出更坚韧的一面，最终成功东山再起，找到了新的事业目标。

programme.title: 最佳爱情
programme.desc: 【知名编剧「洪氏姊妹」执笔当红VS过气偶像间的恋爱罗曼史】正值演艺巅峰的独孤振，不但是广告界宠儿，更是国民好感度第一的男星！而具爱贞则是前当红偶像团体「国宝少女」成员，因过气只好跑跑通告维持生计。独孤振在一次试镜中，因英语程度不佳，丢失了出演机会，没想到这丢人的秘密，居然被具爱贞给知道了！国民喜爱的男星碰上国民唾弃的女星，他们能克服众人的偏见勇敢去爱吗?一场荒谬又有趣的浪漫恋曲即将展开。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣领
programme.desc: 【改编荣获韩国网路小说悬疑类大奖，热血记者金荷娜携手前男友延玗臻联手调查！】擅长挖掘独家新闻的女记者徐贞媛，除事业上的成功，与作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚后生活也令人称羡。某日在犯罪现场成为了目击者，随著越演越烈的风波被怀疑为杀人犯，为证明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰宪寻求帮助，联手找寻真相。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 能成为陌生人吗
programme.desc: 专门负责离婚诉讼的明星律师吴荷拉和丈夫恩范已爱情长跑10年、结婚3年，因恩范外遇出轨导致离婚收场。荷拉时常上电视节目，大谈如何应对离异后的谣言诽谤、前夫不负责闪避赡养费等问题。原本自己开设事务所的恩范，因打输官司穷途末路下找到荷拉就职事务所的代表签下聘用合约。面对「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快乐地过著婚后人生呢？这对欢喜冤家又会擦出什么火花呢？

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 暖阳之下(完)
programme.desc: 【温馨陆剧/二宝＆事业该选谁？ 都市夫妻的两难抉择！】宋思凝怀著梦想只身来到北京，经过多年打拼终于成为公司的人力总监，与创意公司总经理李俊龙成为夫妻，并育有一儿，日子过得幸福美满。但在婚育观上，两人的想法有极大的分歧，经常为了女儿的教育问题争吵，李俊龙希望能与思凝生育二宝，然而正值事业上升期的思凝，面临自我实现与家庭的两难冲突，在大都会生活的两人又该如何抉择呢？

programme.title: 爱情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永携手《社内相亲》薛仁雅寻找幸福小确幸！！！】清雅是一名放弃恋爱和结婚，努力在生活中，连续八年准备警察公务员却无法合格的社会小螺丝。俊辉则是一名对他人毫无兴趣的不婚主义者，不管是爱情、友情还是亲情都秉持N分之一的态度。认识了彼此开始寻找琐碎但现实的小确幸，并开始认知爱情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君(完)
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 能成为陌生人吗
programme.desc: 专门负责离婚诉讼的明星律师吴荷拉和丈夫恩范已爱情长跑10年、结婚3年，因恩范外遇出轨导致离婚收场。荷拉时常上电视节目，大谈如何应对离异后的谣言诽谤、前夫不负责闪避赡养费等问题。原本自己开设事务所的恩范，因打输官司穷途末路下找到荷拉就职事务所的代表签下聘用合约。面对「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快乐地过著婚后人生呢？这对欢喜冤家又会擦出什么火花呢？

programme.title: 向风而行
programme.desc: 【《请叫我总监》谭松韵与《清平乐》王凯，飞向天际携手筑梦！！】鹭洲航空客运飞行部副部长顾南亭因公司改制，与性格飒爽不羁的程霄成为上下属和师徒关系。面对接踵而来的突发航空事件，追求稳定秩序的顾南亭时常被不按常理出牌的程霄打乱计划，共同经历冲击与考验，一路披荆斩棘、相扶成长。

programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the tropical island of Sri Lanka in Southern Asia on a global adventure in search of fishing cats.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr Lo has three sons, Leung, Fay and Kung; and a daughter-in-law, Eliza. While they seem like a normal family, their relationships need mending. Leung and Fay play a prank on their brother Kung on his birthday by falsely claiming that he has won the lottery. This sets off a chain reaction of funny mishaps that finally brings the family together.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Protege
programme.desc: Undercover Police Nick has spent 8 years working for the drug baron Quin, so as to collect evidence of his drug trafficking activities. After gaining Quin's trust, Nick becomes his protege and succeeds him as the drug baron when Quin retires. However, Nick has lost himself in his split life between trading drugs and searching for criminal evidence.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Don't Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Mun undergoes a cornea transplant to correct her blindness, but ends up gaining more than the gift of sight. She shockingly realises that she is seeing another woman instead of herself whenever she looks into a mirror. Recalling that things changed ever since her cornea was replaced, Mun vows to uncover the truth behind her strange vision...

programme.title: The Truth: Final Episode
programme.desc: Raymond's lawyer licence is suspended as he has prevented the course of justice to clear his mother's conviction. He is subsequently framed for murder with every piece of evidence pointing towards him. The only one with proof of his innocence is his dying mother, who fights to stay alive long enough to exonerate her son before it is too late.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - The Night Lights: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder discover a baby Nightlight and must bring him back to Thunder’s home realm.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Shadowy Syndrome of the Sinister Splotch
programme.desc: Captain Underpants becomes a wanted man in underwear when footage surfaces of a robber who looks exactly like him. George and Harold, positive it's an impostor, try to track down the perp and bring him to justice. But can the boys do this before Captain Underpants is found guilty?

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Bizarre Blitzkrieg of the Bothersome Butt-erflies
programme.desc: As a prank, George and Harold use Melvin's new animal hybrid invention to create a creature that's a cross between a butt and a fly. But some of the monster butt-erflies want to eat everything in sight- including the students hiding out in the school gym!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Problematic Pandemonium of the Punishing Plungerina
programme.desc: After helping George and Harold make a comic featuring the heroine Plungerina, Erica asserts that Plungerina could be better that Captain Underpants. To prove her wrong, the boys decide to actually create the villain in the comic and then have Captain Underpants save the day. Unfortunately, Krupp - and therefore Captain Underpants - is away at a principals' convention.There's no one to save them...until a real life Plungerina saves tthe day! But who is really Plungerina?

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - A Grim Retreat
programme.desc: The Riders head to a tropical island for fun in the sun, not realizing it's infested with Grimora Leeches which drives their dragons to turn on them.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - To Heather Or Not To Heather
programme.desc: When Heather and Windshear land on Dragon's Edge to join the Dragon Rider crew, they quickly discover that Windshear doesn't play well with others.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - The Colony
programme.desc: Keith and Krolia discover troubling details about Lotor

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Grugs First Chance Furry Road
programme.desc: Tired of settling disputes between Valleyites, Grug invents "Chance," a two-sided rock that can be flipped to determine all decisions in the Valley; In a nature documentary-style, Thunk tells the story of Beary, a peaceful Thunk-like cub that struggles to fit into a violent bear owl culture

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Girl Who Cried Wolf
programme.desc: While Lucky and Spirit continue to explore a life in the circus, best friends Pru and Abigail set out to lasso in their friend back home. With new frontiers, new sights, and new friends the PALs ride free like never-before on wild circus adventures only to realize that there's no place like home.

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - The Return
programme.desc: The Dinotrux return to the crater from their travels to find that D-Structs has taken over and built a huge wall to keep them out.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Hooting Huffty
programme.desc: Hufftys not feeling well so his friends try to cheer him up with games but his loud elephant sneezes keep interrupting. Thats until Raa Raa thinks up a way to make his sneezes part of the fun

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Jungle Lookout
programme.desc: Raa Raa and his friends have fun searching the Jingly Jangly Jungle for Hufftys whooshy whooshers.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Noisy Mystery
programme.desc: Raa Raa and his friends hear a strange noise and find a set of tracks in the Jungle but what could be making them

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Coolest Hello
programme.desc: Raa Raa and his friends come up with lots of different ways to say hello to make one cool greeting.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Bell Flowers
programme.desc: Raa Raa is waiting for the beautiful Bell Flowers to open but can the fidgety lion sit still long enough to see one

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion S2 - Raa Raa And The Funniest Laugh
programme.desc: Raa Raa and his friends try to find things that make funny noises in the Jingly Jangly Jungle.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - MerCat Gets Her Sparkle Back
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes beakers filled with a magical potion, they conjure up an invite for Spa Day at the dollhouse! However, while decorating for MerCat's favorite day of the year, MerCat accidentally loses her color and sparkle. Gabby and Pandy must help her get her sparkle back for the big Spa Day party!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Itty Bitty Blossom
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a special plant called an Itty Bitty Blossom that goes from newborn to full-grown in one day. Gabby and Pandy have to take care of the whiny and fussy growing Itty Bitty Blossom and make sure it is in its permanent soil spot before it's fully grown.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Terrifying Perilous Misfortune of the T.P. Mummy
programme.desc: After George and Harold T.P. the entire school with toilet paper, they are forced to flush it all down the toilet causing a giant explosion that turns the French teacher into the T.P. Mummy

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Imaginary Friends
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into "Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Thunk Tank
programme.desc: When a freak lightning strike turns Thunk into a genius, Phil is thrilled to have someone likeminded on the farm, until the farm residents start asking Thunk for help with problems on the farm instead of him.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Downpour
programme.desc: Tom and Thunder train a new species of aggressive tidal dragons to help the other riders put out a forest fire threatening ICARIS.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Chinese Nian Year Pt. 2
programme.desc: Yi realizes that Peng and Everest were taken by Nian, the legendary dragon-like creature associated with Chinese New Year - and he’s also taken their other creature friends! With Burnish and Duchess’ help, Yi and Jin travel outside of the city to find Nian’s cave. But a skirmish in the cave drives the conflict with Nian back to the city, wreacking havoc on the festival. The crew and creatures band together to try to stop Nian, but they’re no match.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - CJ WooferbugWhat Did I Miss
programme.desc: DJ is excited to give her niece CJ her own wooferbug for her birthday. But the wooferbug proves difficult to transport across Trolls Village. Will DJ be able to get it to CJ before CJ’s birthday party ends?When Peppy takes an entire day to get a new haircut, he asks Poppy to fill him in on what he missed. What follows is a series of short sketches, as we explore an average day in Troll Village.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! Gabby and Pandy make her some delicious dandelion soup and while she rests, they take care of her Garden. With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - She Said, She Said Starfish
programme.desc: When one of Rikki’s plants won't sing, Pixie and Juniper both tell their varying recollections of why the plant is suddenly silent. Kelp, Scallop, and Cruz have always thought that starfish did nothing but laze about; but as they go about their day, the starfish goes through his own routine, completely unbeknownst to everyone else.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Leroy’s Caterpillar Lost Spark
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper look for the plant they think will cure her. Meanwhile Pixie wonders whether she can be cured at all!

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Tanaka's Moving Castle Zenko Don't Go
programme.desc: Mr. Tanaka is moving places all by himself, so Team Zenko step in to assist, and learn the importance of asking people for help. When Sam's skateboard competition falls on the same day as her favourite creator Ken KaBlam's comic book signing, TZG secretly prevents him leaving town before she gets the chance to meet him.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Driven to Distraction To Bee or Not To Bee
programme.desc: When easily-distracted Luis is tasked with getting flowers for his grandmother's birthday party, TZG secretly keeps him on track. When Rodney's honey bees escape from their apiary (artificial beehive), TZG secretly brings them back.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Hot, Hot, Hot
programme.desc: Aggro is embarrassed about big changes she's going through. And when she gets stuck in a volcano, the Rescue Riders seek help from ... Magnus?

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Hot, Hot, Hot
programme.desc: When a mama Ironclaw dragon gets caught high on a mountain with a broken wing, Hannahr the blacksmith has to confront her fear of heights to help out.
